skill.name: clipcat
skill.description: Research TikTok Shop markets, adapt proven selling-video prompts, generate product media, analyze videos, and track Clipcat tasks through the Clipcat CLI.
skill.summary: Research TikTok commerce and create product videos with the Clipcat CLI.
skill.author: clipcat-ai

security_audit.summary: Most static command findings mistake Markdown backticks and documentation for executable code. However, the skill directly executes mutable remote installers, handles an API key, updates its CLI, accesses local task state, and uploads media to Clipcat.

remediation.issue: Remote installer content is piped directly into bash and Invoke-Expression.
remediation.suggestion: Publish versioned installers with checksums or signatures. Download a pinned release, verify it, show the command, and require user approval before execution.

remediation.issue: The workflow runs CLI updates automatically after an update notice.
remediation.suggestion: Pin an audited CLI version and require explicit user approval before every update. Verify the new release signature before replacing the executable.

remediation.issue: Local product images and videos are uploaded to an external service.
remediation.suggestion: Require explicit consent before upload. State the destination, retention policy, file limits, and whether generated links expose the media.

remediation.issue: The skill stores task metadata in a hidden home-directory file.
remediation.suggestion: Document the stored fields, permissions, retention, and deletion process. Use restrictive file permissions and never store API keys in task history.

content.user_title: Research TikTok Products and Create Selling Videos
content.value_statement: TikTok Shop research and selling-video production require many separate tools. Clipcat combines commerce data, proven prompts, media generation, and task tracking.
actual_capabilities: Searches TikTok Shop creators, products, sellers, videos, live rooms, hashtags, and music through Clipcat commands.
Finds selling-video prompts derived from high-GMV TikTok examples and adapts them to a selected product.
Generates product videos and e-commerce images from prompts, local media, or remote image references.
Replicates reference-video structure with product images after quoting and confirming the required credits.
Analyzes video scripts, scenes, and music, and downloads supported TikTok or Douyin videos.
Tracks asynchronous generation, analysis, image, and download tasks across conversations.
limitations: Requires the external Clipcat CLI, a Clipcat account, and an API key.
Research coverage varies, and historical datasets may omit public entities or recent activity.
Most research and generation commands consume credits, while premium models require a paid plan.
Local media is uploaded to Clipcat for remote processing, and model availability can change.

use_cases.title: Validate Product Opportunities
use_cases.description: Compare product, seller, creator, and video performance before selecting a TikTok Shop campaign direction.

use_cases.title: Adapt Proven Creative
use_cases.description: Find a relevant high-GMV video prompt and rewrite its structure for a new product and audience.

use_cases.title: Produce Product Media
use_cases.description: Generate product images or videos, confirm costs, submit tasks, and monitor results.

prompt_templates.title: Find Leading Products
prompt_templates.prompt: Research leading TikTok Shop products in [category] for [region]. Compare sales, GMV, price, and recent trends.

prompt_templates.title: Compare Competitors
prompt_templates.prompt: Compare [seller or product] with three relevant competitors. Summarize creator activity, selling videos, pricing, and evidence-backed opportunities.

prompt_templates.title: Create a Selling-Video Prompt
prompt_templates.prompt: Find proven prompts for [product] targeting [audience]. Adapt the strongest match, remove unsupported claims, and cite the source before generation.

prompt_templates.title: Plan and Generate a Campaign Asset
prompt_templates.prompt: Research [market], select a proven creative structure, propose model settings, quote credits, request approval, generate the asset, and track completion.

output_examples.input: Research serum selling videos in the United States and identify a useful creative pattern.
output: Top pattern: handheld bathroom demonstration with the product visible in the opening two seconds.
Evidence: the selected source combines strong sales with a close match to the requested audience and setting.
Next step: adapt its shot order and voiceover while removing unsupported efficacy claims.

output_examples.input: Create an eight-second vertical product video from my image using a standard model.
output: Recommended settings: Seedance 2, 480p, eight seconds, vertical format.
The current quote is 160 credits. Generation will start only after explicit approval.
The image will be uploaded to Clipcat for remote processing.

output_examples.input: Check my latest image generation task.
output_examples.output: The latest image task is still processing. Check again in about 30 seconds using its saved task identifier.

best_practices: Run command help before unfamiliar operations because supported flags and models can change.
Quote every paid generation with identical settings, show the cost, and obtain explicit approval before submission.
Use proven prompts as structure, replace product details, and remove claims that the user cannot support.
anti_patterns: Do not retry empty historical queries when the entity may only exist in current public data.
Do not guess identifiers, model availability, prices, or category levels.
Do not upload media, spend credits, increase resolution, or update the CLI without explicit user approval.

faq.question: What do I need before using Clipcat?
faq.answer: You need the Clipcat CLI, a Clipcat account, and a configured API key.

faq.question: Does every command consume credits?
faq.answer: No. Some account metadata is free, but research and generation commands can consume credits.

faq.question: Can Clipcat research any TikTok account or video?
faq.answer: Current public data has broad coverage, while historical commerce datasets may not include every entity.

faq.question: How are paid generations approved?
faq.answer: The skill requests a server quote, shows the exact settings and cost, and waits for explicit approval.

faq.question: Where are local files processed?
faq.answer: Selected images and videos are uploaded to Clipcat for remote processing through its API.

faq.question: Can long-running tasks finish in one command?
faq.answer: No. Generation and analysis tasks return identifiers and require later status checks.
